mapper.select: SELECT id, reporter_id AS reporterId, target_user_id AS targetUserId, reason, title, content, status, processed_at AS processedAt FROM mingle_reports ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC

SELECT id, reporter_id AS reporterId, target_user_id AS targetUserId, reason, title, content, status, processed_at AS processedAt FROM mingle_reports WHERE reporter_id = #{reporterId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_reports SET status = #{status}, processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{reportId} AND #{status} IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')
